text: A failed build's card on the dashboard leads with what its pull request is now (#865). The factory's record says how it was when the factory stopped; a pull request that has since passed CI's gate was still described as a draft whose only action closed it, and one that conflicted was still offered a merge. Each refresh reads the pull request of every card that names one, and CI's gate on its head: two conditional requests a card. The card says whether it's open, a draft and able to merge, how the gate went, or that it has merged or closed. One that can merge as it stands is offered for review first, and a retry leads otherwise. A card whose pull request can't be read says nothing of now.
